knowledge_entries.name: fermentation_area_overview
knowledge_entries.text: The Fermentation Area, located at the rear center of the room near coordinates x=0, z=-6, features multiple fermentation models and nutrition panels such as objects 001, 007, 013, and 025. These freestanding displays illustrate various fermentation processes and their nutritional benefits, providing visitors with detailed insights into food fermentation and microbiology.

knowledge_entries.name: nutrition_and_microbiology_in_fermentation
knowledge_entries.text: Nutrition panels in the Fermentation Area, including objects 004, 010, and 016, explain the microbiological aspects and health benefits of fermented foods. These exhibits support understanding of how fermentation enhances nutritional value and contributes to food science education.

knowledge_entries.name: supply_chain_area_and_milling_models
knowledge_entries.text: The Supply Chain Area, centered around x=0, z=-5.5, contains supply maps and milling models like objects 002, 008, and 014. These educational displays demonstrate the logistics of food supply chains and milling processes, illustrating how grains move from production to processing within the food supply network.

knowledge_entries.name: logistics_and_food_processing_exhibits
knowledge_entries.text: Interactive milling models and supply maps in the Supply Chain Area provide detailed explanations of food processing and logistics. Objects such as 005 and 011 help visitors understand the complexities of milling and distribution within the food supply chain.

knowledge_entries.name: grain_and_preservation_area_displays
knowledge_entries.text: Located near x=0, z=-4.0, the Grain and Preservation Area showcases grain displays and preservation stations including objects 003, 006, 009, and 033. These exhibits educate visitors on various grain types, their nutritional roles, and preservation techniques essential for food sustainability and agriculture.

knowledge_entries.name: food_preservation_techniques
knowledge_entries.text: Preservation stations in the Grain and Preservation Area, such as objects 006, 012, and 018, demonstrate methods of food preservation. These interactive displays highlight techniques that extend shelf life and maintain food quality, supporting visitor understanding of preservation's role in nutrition and agriculture.

knowledge_entries.name: agricultural_context_of_grains
knowledge_entries.text: Grain displays throughout the Grain and Preservation Area provide insights into agricultural practices and grain varieties. Objects like 003, 015, and 039 illustrate the connection between agriculture, grain production, and their importance in food science and nutrition education.

knowledge_entries.name: food_science_integration_in_fermentation
knowledge_entries.text: The Fermentation Area integrates food science concepts through models and panels that explain biochemical processes in fermentation. Exhibits such as object 025 provide a comprehensive view of how fermentation impacts food quality, safety, and nutrition, enriching the educational experience.
